subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: The weather and us: clothes, food and activities for different weather

show.line: Weather changes what we wear, eat and do. Hot day? Cold day? Rainy day?

rounds.prompt: It is raining. What do you take?
A cold day. Which food warms you up?
A hot sunny day. What can you do?
Rainy day or sunny day? Sort them.
What protects your eyes from bright sun?

hints: Think: is it hot, cold or wet?
The sun is too bright for our eyes.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The sun is out.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will stare right at the sun!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Never look straight at the sun. It hurts eyes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Never look at the sun. Wear a hat!

parent_line: Knows how weather affects clothes, food and activities, and to protect eyes from the sun.
